statement: 用户在获知 corrected relative feasibility gate 会冻结 alpha=.75 且独立 128-record validation 四项 relative checks 全部通过，但最终 2595-record SOW 仍无法保证后，明确回复‘lets do this xiuzheng now’。现批准执行 hash-bound config configs/foundir_blur_only_flux2_scalar_residual_full_development_v1.json：exact step-10k parent、alpha 永久冻结为 .75、原 full-development crop seed 2026091111、inference seed 2026091113 与 namespace blur_full_development、全部 2595 source-disjoint development records；同时 paired replay alpha=1 以验证可比性。严禁用 development GT 调 alpha、模型权重更新、自动后续训练、Qwen degradation conditioning、mixed degradation、distillation、decoder tuning、sealed internal 和 official FoundIR test；失败即停止。该记录是 USER authorization，不代表或捏造 advisor 回复。
